title.en: Fable 23 — The Fox and the Crow

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: עורב ישב על ענף עם גבינה.
sentences.en: A crow sat on a branch with cheese.
A fox stood below and looked.

sentences.ar: השועל אמר: אתה הציפור הכי יפה.
sentences.en: The fox said: you are the most beautiful bird.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: בטח יש לך גם קול יפה.
sentences.en: He said: surely you have a beautiful voice too.
The crow opened his mouth and sang.
The cheese fell and the fox took it.
Whoever loves compliments pays for them.
